rule_zh: 当个体接收到相互矛盾的新旧信息时，其信念更新倾向于以最后一次明确获取的有效信息为准。
rule_en: When an individual receives conflicting new and old information, belief updating tends to prioritize the most recently explicitly acquired valid information.
text: When an individual receives conflicting new and old information, belief updating tends to prioritize the most recently explicitly acquired valid information.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若A无法确认B是否接触过特定信息源，则A在推断B的信念时应默认该信息对B不可见。
rule_en: If A cannot confirm whether B has been exposed to a specific information source, A should assume by default that the information is unavailable to B when inferring B's beliefs.
text: If A cannot confirm whether B has been exposed to a specific information source, A should assume by default that the information is unavailable to B when inferring B's beliefs.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 在缺乏明确交互或反馈时，个体倾向于假设他人与自己持有相同的背景知识与常识信念。
rule_en: In the absence of explicit interaction or feedback, individuals tend to assume that others share the same background knowledge and common-sense beliefs.
text: In the absence of explicit interaction or feedback, individuals tend to assume that others share the same background knowledge and common-sense beliefs.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若某事件的发生被物理屏障或个体注意力转移完全阻断，未察觉者不会自动更新原有信念。
rule_en: If the occurrence of an event is completely blocked by physical barriers or attentional diversion, unaware observers do not automatically update their prior beliefs.
text: If the occurrence of an event is completely blocked by physical barriers or attentional diversion, unaware observers do not automatically update their prior beliefs.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 当信息持有者故意隐瞒关键事实以引导他人时，接收方的信念将基于残缺信息构建，而隐瞒方清楚此认知落差。
rule_en: When an information holder intentionally withholds key facts to influence others, the receiver's beliefs are formed from incomplete information, while the concealer remains aware of this cognitive disparity.
text: When an information holder intentionally withholds key facts to influence others, the receiver's beliefs are formed from incomplete information, while the concealer remains aware of this cognitive disparity.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 嵌套信念的推理深度受限于个体对他人认知处理能力的预估，通常止于实际交互需求层级。
rule_en: The depth of nested belief reasoning is constrained by an individual's estimation of others' cognitive processing capacity, typically terminating at the level required for practical interaction.
text: The depth of nested belief reasoning is constrained by an individual's estimation of others' cognitive processing capacity, typically terminating at the level required for practical interaction.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若A观察到B的言行与客观环境状态相悖，A应优先推断B持有错误或受限的信念，而非环境本身异常。
rule_en: If A observes that B's behavior contradicts the objective environmental state, A should prioritize inferring that B holds false or constrained beliefs rather than assuming the environment itself is anomalous.
text: If A observes that B's behavior contradicts the objective environmental state, A should prioritize inferring that B holds false or constrained beliefs rather than assuming the environment itself is anomalous.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 经由第三方转述或间接渠道获取的信息，其形成的信念确信度通常低于直接感知所得。
rule_en: Information acquired via third-party relay or indirect channels typically yields beliefs of lower certainty than those formed through direct perception.
text: Information acquired via third-party relay or indirect channels typically yields beliefs of lower certainty than those formed through direct perception.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 偷看者获取隐秘信息后若保持沉默，其自身信念虽已更新，但他人对其心理状态的推测仍维持旧有模型。
rule_en: If a covert observer acquires secret information yet remains silent, their own beliefs update, while others' inferences about their mental state remain anchored to the prior model.
text: If a covert observer acquires secret information yet remains silent, their own beliefs update, while others' inferences about their mental state remain anchored to the prior model.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若A基于对B的错误信念推断采取行动，该行动的内在逻辑由A的推断信念驱动，而非客观事实。
rule_en: If A acts based on an erroneously inferred belief about B, the internal logic of that action is driven by A's inferred belief rather than objective facts.
text: If A acts based on an erroneously inferred belief about B, the internal logic of that action is driven by A's inferred belief rather than objective facts.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 共同在场的个体若缺乏视线交汇或语言沟通，各自独立感知将形成互不相通的平行信念状态。
rule_en: When co-present individuals lack mutual gaze or verbal communication, their independent perceptions yield mutually isolated parallel belief states.
text: When co-present individuals lack mutual gaze or verbal communication, their independent perceptions yield mutually isolated parallel belief states.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 当信念出现潜在冲突时，理性个体倾向于设计试探性提问或观察反应行为，以验证他人真实信念。
rule_en: When potential belief conflicts arise, rational individuals tend to formulate probing questions or observe behavioral responses to verify others' true beliefs.
text: When potential belief conflicts arise, rational individuals tend to formulate probing questions or observe behavioral responses to verify others' true beliefs.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 秘密观察所得信息若与既有核心信念强烈冲突，个体可能启动防御机制并选择性维持原有信念。
rule_en: When information obtained through covert observation strongly conflicts with preexisting core beliefs, individuals may activate defense mechanisms and selectively maintain their original beliefs.
text: When information obtained through covert observation strongly conflicts with preexisting core beliefs, individuals may activate defense mechanisms and selectively maintain their original beliefs.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若A确知B曾接收过误导性信息，A在预测B行为时应以该误导信息为基准，而非客观真实情况。
rule_en: If A knows for certain that B has received misleading information, A should base predictions of B's behavior on that information rather than on objective reality.
text: If A knows for certain that B has received misleading information, A should base predictions of B's behavior on that information rather than on objective reality.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 解析多层嵌套信念时，必须严格锚定每一层主体最后接触的信息节点，逐层向上或向下推导。
rule_en: When analyzing multi-layered nested beliefs, strictly anchor to the information node last accessed by the agent at each level, and conduct layer-by-layer upward or downward inference.
text: When analyzing multi-layered nested beliefs, strictly anchor to the information node last accessed by the agent at each level, and conduct layer-by-layer upward or downward inference.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 注意力焦点决定信息摄入的有效性，即使线索显著，未被个体注意亦不会触发信念更新。
rule_en: Attentional focus determines the efficacy of information intake; unattended cues, however salient, fail to trigger belief updating.
text: Attentional focus determines the efficacy of information intake; unattended cues, however salient, fail to trigger belief updating.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 当个体信念引导的行动结果持续偏离预期，会触发信念回溯机制并重新评估初始信息源的可靠性。
rule_en: When outcomes of belief-guided actions persistently deviate from expectations, a belief backtracking mechanism is triggered to reassess the reliability of the initial information source.
text: When outcomes of belief-guided actions persistently deviate from expectations, a belief backtracking mechanism is triggered to reassess the reliability of the initial information source.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 隐秘观察行为一旦被当事人察觉，信息不对称状态即刻瓦解，双方信念转为基于公开事实的共同知识。
rule_en: Once a covert observation is detected by the observed party, information asymmetry instantly collapses, and both parties' beliefs converge to common knowledge grounded in public facts.
text: Once a covert observation is detected by the observed party, information asymmetry instantly collapses, and both parties' beliefs converge to common knowledge grounded in public facts.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若A故意陈述虚假信息且B信以为真，A维持真实信念与操纵意图，B的信念则被成功植入并发生偏移。
rule_en: If A intentionally asserts false information and B accepts it as true, and A maintains the true belief and manipulative intent, B's belief is successfully implanted and shifted.
text: If A intentionally asserts false information and B accepts it as true, and A maintains the true belief and manipulative intent, B's belief is successfully implanted and shifted.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 在状态频繁变化的环境中，未及时同步信息的个体信念会冻结在其最后一次有效接收信息的时刻。
rule_en: In environments with frequent state changes, individual beliefs lacking timely synchronization become frozen at the timestamp of their last valid information reception.
text: In environments with frequent state changes, individual beliefs lacking timely synchronization become frozen at the timestamp of their last valid information reception.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 群体表面的一致信念可能掩盖内部个体因私有信息差异而产生的真实认知分歧。
rule_en: Apparent group consensus may obscure genuine cognitive divergence among individuals stemming from differences in private information.
text: Apparent group consensus may obscure genuine cognitive divergence among individuals stemming from differences in private information.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 对他人信念的推断需结合其性格倾向、过往经验与当前动机进行校准，而非仅依赖当前单一行为。
rule_en: Inferences regarding others' beliefs must be calibrated by integrating their personality dispositions, prior experiences, and current motivations, rather than relying solely on a single current behavior.
text: Inferences regarding others' beliefs must be calibrated by integrating their personality dispositions, prior experiences, and current motivations, rather than relying solely on a single current behavior.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若A推断B不知情，但A自身遗漏了B可能获取该信息的潜在渠道，则A的嵌套推断存在结构性盲区。
rule_en: If A infers that B is unaware but overlooks potential channels through which B might acquire the information, A's nested inference exhibits a structural blind spot.
text: If A infers that B is unaware but overlooks potential channels through which B might acquire the information, A's nested inference exhibits a structural blind spot.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 环境布置的微妙变化可更新敏锐观察者的信念，但未置身该环境或未注意到变化的个体信念不受影响。
rule_en: Subtle changes in environmental configuration can update the beliefs of perceptive observers, whereas the beliefs of individuals not present in the environment or unaware of the changes remain unaffected.
text: Subtle changes in environmental configuration can update the beliefs of perceptive observers, whereas the beliefs of individuals not present in the environment or unaware of the changes remain unaffected.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 信念传递经过的中介环节越多，信息失真风险越高，终端接收者的信念可能与原始事实存在显著偏差。
rule_en: The greater the number of intermediary steps in belief transmission, the higher the risk of information distortion, and the more likely the final recipient's belief will significantly deviate from the original facts.
text: The greater the number of intermediary steps in belief transmission, the higher the risk of information distortion, and the more likely the final recipient's belief will significantly deviate from the original facts.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 当发现他人信念与事实相悖且缺乏确凿反证时，个体通常会保留认知差异而不强行干预或纠正。
rule_en: Upon observing that others' beliefs contradict factual reality and conclusive disconfirming evidence is absent, individuals typically preserve the cognitive discrepancy without resorting to coercive intervention or correction.
text: Upon observing that others' beliefs contradict factual reality and conclusive disconfirming evidence is absent, individuals typically preserve the cognitive discrepancy without resorting to coercive intervention or correction.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 秘密行动者的心理状态完全独立于被观察目标，除非留下可追溯的痕迹，否则不扰动目标的信念链条。
rule_en: The psychological state of a covert operator remains strictly independent of the observed target, and does not perturb the target's belief chain unless detectable traces are left.
text: The psychological state of a covert operator remains strictly independent of the observed target, and does not perturb the target's belief chain unless detectable traces are left.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若某人宣称持有特定信念却无法提供合理解释或证据，观察者应下调对该信念准确性的置信度。
rule_en: If an individual asserts a specific belief yet fails to provide reasonable justification or evidence, the observer should lower their confidence in its accuracy.
text: If an individual asserts a specific belief yet fails to provide reasonable justification or evidence, the observer should lower their confidence in its accuracy.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 除非出现明确的遗忘信号或时间跨度极大，否则默认他人已获取的明确信息会稳定保留在其信念库中。
rule_en: Unless explicit forgetting signals or a substantially extended time span are present, explicitly acquired information is presumed by default to remain stably retained in others' belief repositories.
text: Unless explicit forgetting signals or a substantially extended time span are present, explicitly acquired information is presumed by default to remain stably retained in others' belief repositories.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 在信念推理中需严格区分客观事实与主观确信，主体的行为始终由其主观认定的信念而非事实真相驱动。
rule_en: In belief reasoning, a strict distinction must be maintained between objective facts and subjective certainty; an agent's behavior is invariably driven by subjectively held beliefs rather than factual truth.
text: In belief reasoning, a strict distinction must be maintained between objective facts and subjective certainty; an agent's behavior is invariably driven by subjectively held beliefs rather than factual truth.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 无意识的非语言泄露可能被高阶观察者捕获，从而更新其对泄露者隐藏信念的推测。
rule_en: Unconscious nonverbal leakage may be detected by higher-order observers, thereby updating their inferences about the leaker's hidden beliefs.
text: Unconscious nonverbal leakage may be detected by higher-order observers, thereby updating their inferences about the leaker's hidden beliefs.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 信息获取与状态更新之间的时间差会导致信念滞后，延迟输入的信息可能已无法准确映射当前现实。
rule_en: The temporal delay between information acquisition and state updating induces belief lag; delayed inputs may no longer accurately map to current reality.
text: The temporal delay between information acquisition and state updating induces belief lag; delayed inputs may no longer accurately map to current reality.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 社会压力或群体共识会促使个体公开表达的信念与其私下真实信念发生解离，推理时需区分表里状态。
rule_en: Social pressure or group consensus induces a divergence between publicly expressed and privately held beliefs; reasoning must distinguish between outward and internal states.
text: Social pressure or group consensus induces a divergence between publicly expressed and privately held beliefs; reasoning must distinguish between outward and internal states.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 偷看者目睹事件中途反转后，其信念会实时迭代，但未参与观察的局外人仍按线性发展轨迹预测后续。
rule_en: After witnessing a mid-event reversal, an observer's beliefs undergo real-time iterative updating, whereas non-observing outsiders continue to predict subsequent developments along a linear trajectory.
text: After witnessing a mid-event reversal, an observer's beliefs undergo real-time iterative updating, whereas non-observing outsiders continue to predict subsequent developments along a linear trajectory.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 解决深层信念分歧通常依赖引入双方共同认可的独立参照物或建立共享体验，而非单方面说服。
rule_en: Resolving deep-seated belief differences typically relies on introducing mutually acknowledged independent reference points or establishing shared experiences, rather than unilateral persuasion.
text: Resolving deep-seated belief differences typically relies on introducing mutually acknowledged independent reference points or establishing shared experiences, rather than unilateral persuasion.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若A低估B的专业背景或领域知识，A在嵌套推断中易误判B的信息整合与信念推理能力。
rule_en: If A underestimates B's professional background or domain knowledge, A is prone to misjudge B's capacity for information integration and belief reasoning in nested inference.
text: If A underestimates B's professional background or domain knowledge, A is prone to misjudge B's capacity for information integration and belief reasoning in nested inference.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 模糊的环境线索可能被不同个体依据各自先验知识赋予差异化解释，导致对同一场景形成异质信念。
rule_en: Ambiguous environmental cues may be differentially interpreted by individuals based on their respective prior knowledge, resulting in heterogeneous beliefs about the same context.
text: Ambiguous environmental cues may be differentially interpreted by individuals based on their respective prior knowledge, resulting in heterogeneous beliefs about the same context.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 嵌套信念链中任一环节的信息可见性误判，都会引发后续所有层级推理的级联错误。
rule_en: Misjudgment of information visibility at any link in a nested belief chain triggers cascading errors across all subsequent levels of reasoning.
text: Misjudgment of information visibility at any link in a nested belief chain triggers cascading errors across all subsequent levels of reasoning.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 当群体共享的信念体系与客观现实持续背离时，通常需引入系统外部的全新独立信息源才能打破共识闭环。
rule_en: When a collective belief system persistently diverges from objective reality, introducing entirely new, independent information sources external to the system is typically required to break the closed consensus loop.
text: When a collective belief system persistently diverges from objective reality, introducing entirely new, independent information sources external to the system is typically required to break the closed consensus loop.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 个体在缺乏特定情境知识时，倾向于用已有经验中的熟悉模式填补认知空白以维持假装互动。
rule_en: In the absence of specific situational knowledge, individuals tend to rely on familiar patterns from prior experience to fill cognitive gaps and maintain pretend interactions.
text: In the absence of specific situational knowledge, individuals tend to rely on familiar patterns from prior experience to fill cognitive gaps and maintain pretend interactions.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 假装场景中的符号指代仅对共享该约定的参与者有效，未进入该语境的观察者会按字面意义解读。
rule_en: Within pretend contexts, symbolic reference applies exclusively to participants sharing the convention; observers outside this frame will interpret it literally.
text: Within pretend contexts, symbolic reference applies exclusively to participants sharing the convention; observers outside this frame will interpret it literally.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 当假装道具的物理特征与预期功能严重冲突时，参与者会优先依据实际物理反馈调整假装行为。
rule_en: When the physical properties of pretend props significantly conflict with their intended functions, participants primarily rely on actual physical feedback to adjust their pretend behavior.
text: When the physical properties of pretend props significantly conflict with their intended functions, participants primarily rely on actual physical feedback to adjust their pretend behavior.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 假装情境中赋予对象的临时属性不会自动迁移到现实交互中，除非互动方明确建立泛化联结。
rule_en: Temporary attributes assigned to objects in pretend contexts do not automatically transfer to real-world interactions unless interacting parties explicitly establish a generalized connection.
text: Temporary attributes assigned to objects in pretend contexts do not automatically transfer to real-world interactions unless interacting parties explicitly establish a generalized connection.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 认知经验不足的个体无法区分假装情境中的故意偏离与真实失误，容易将其归因为能力缺陷。
rule_en: Individuals with insufficient cognitive experience are unable to distinguish intentional deviations in pretend contexts from genuine errors, readily attributing them to competence deficits.
text: Individuals with insufficient cognitive experience are unable to distinguish intentional deviations in pretend contexts from genuine errors, readily attributing them to competence deficits.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 多个参与者共同维持假装状态需要持续的非语言线索确认，线索中断会导致假装共识瓦解。
rule_en: Maintaining a shared pretense among multiple participants requires continuous nonverbal cue confirmation; disruption of these cues leads to the collapse of the pretense consensus.
text: Maintaining a shared pretense among multiple participants requires continuous nonverbal cue confirmation; disruption of these cues leads to the collapse of the pretense consensus.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 对物品原始用途无认知的个体，在假装游戏中会自发赋予其基于当前语境的新功能。
rule_en: Individuals unaware of an object's original function spontaneously ascribe novel, context-dependent functions to it during pretend play.
text: Individuals unaware of an object's original function spontaneously ascribe novel, context-dependent functions to it during pretend play.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 假装行为中的规则违反若未被当场指出，参与者会默认其已被纳入新的假装共识中。
rule_en: If unchallenged in the moment, participants tacitly assume that rule violations within pretense have been incorporated into a revised pretense consensus.
text: If unchallenged in the moment, participants tacitly assume that rule violations within pretense have been incorporated into a revised pretense consensus.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 当个体无法理解他人的假装意图时，会倾向于将该行为解释为无意义的重复动作或真实需求。
rule_en: When individuals fail to understand others' pretend intentions, they tend to interpret such behavior as meaningless repetitive actions or genuine needs.
text: When individuals fail to understand others' pretend intentions, they tend to interpret such behavior as meaningless repetitive actions or genuine needs.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 当奉承话语与客观事实存在明显偏差时，听者会启动防御性归因机制而非盲目采信。
rule_en: When flattering remarks markedly diverge from objective facts, listeners activate a defensive attribution mechanism rather than accept them uncritically.
text: When flattering remarks markedly diverge from objective facts, listeners activate a defensive attribution mechanism rather than accept them uncritically.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 说话者若长期以奉承作为主要沟通策略，听者会对其所有正面评价产生意图透明度折损。
rule_en: If a speaker consistently employs flattery as a primary communication strategy, listeners will perceive diminished intention transparency across all positive evaluations.
text: If a speaker consistently employs flattery as a primary communication strategy, listeners will perceive diminished intention transparency across all positive evaluations.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 第三方对奉承动机的识破不改变该话语对直接接收者的情感影响，除非第三方介入揭露。
rule_en: Third-party recognition of flattery motives does not alter the emotional impact of the utterance on the direct recipient unless the third party intervenes to expose it.
text: Third-party recognition of flattery motives does not alter the emotional impact of the utterance on the direct recipient unless the third party intervenes to expose it.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 奉承话语中的具体化细节越多，其掩饰真实意图的伪装性越强，而非意图越真诚。
rule_en: The greater the specificity of details in flattering remarks, the stronger their capacity to conceal true intentions, rather than indicating greater sincerity.
text: The greater the specificity of details in flattering remarks, the stronger their capacity to conceal true intentions, rather than indicating greater sincerity.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 权力不对等关系中，弱势方的奉承话语意图透明度天然较高，接收者默认其包含顺从信号。
rule_en: In asymmetrical power relations, flattery from subordinate parties inherently exhibits high transparency of intent, with recipients automatically interpreting it as signaling compliance.
text: In asymmetrical power relations, flattery from subordinate parties inherently exhibits high transparency of intent, with recipients automatically interpreting it as signaling compliance.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 奉承行为若伴随即时请求，其真实意图会迅速显性化，伪装层将主动剥离。
rule_en: When flattery accompanies an immediate request, true intent rapidly becomes explicit, and the facade spontaneously dissolves.
text: When flattery accompanies an immediate request, true intent rapidly becomes explicit, and the facade spontaneously dissolves.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 接收者即使识破奉承意图，也可能出于社交礼仪维持表面认同，形成意图共谋。
rule_en: Even upon recognizing the flattering intent, recipients may maintain superficial agreement due to politeness norms, thereby forming a collusion of intent.
text: Even upon recognizing the flattering intent, recipients may maintain superficial agreement due to politeness norms, thereby forming a collusion of intent.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 个体在认知资源受限时，会优先处理话语或行为的表层功能，忽略其潜在的假装或策略意图。
rule_en: Under cognitive resource constraints, individuals prioritize processing the surface-level functions of speech or behavior, overlooking their underlying deceptive or strategic intentions.
text: Under cognitive resource constraints, individuals prioritize processing the surface-level functions of speech or behavior, overlooking their underlying deceptive or strategic intentions.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 社会互动中的心照不宣状态依赖于双方对意图透明度的默契容忍，打破该状态会导致假装或奉承失效。
rule_en: The state of tacit understanding in social interactions depends on both parties' implicit tolerance for the transparency of intentions, and disrupting this state renders pretense or flattery ineffective.
text: The state of tacit understanding in social interactions depends on both parties' implicit tolerance for the transparency of intentions, and disrupting this state renders pretense or flattery ineffective.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 当说话者自身对奉承内容的信念不足时，其非语言信号会泄露意图的非真实性，降低意图透明度。
rule_en: When a speaker lacks sufficient conviction in the flattering content, nonverbal cues leak the inauthenticity of the intent, reducing intention transparency.
text: When a speaker lacks sufficient conviction in the flattering content, nonverbal cues leak the inauthenticity of the intent, reducing intention transparency.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 假装游戏中的角色转换需要参与者暂时抑制自我知识，认知抑制能力弱的个体容易混淆假装与现实。
rule_en: Role switching in pretend play requires participants to temporarily inhibit self-knowledge; individuals with weak cognitive inhibition are prone to confusing pretense with reality.
text: Role switching in pretend play requires participants to temporarily inhibit self-knowledge; individuals with weak cognitive inhibition are prone to confusing pretense with reality.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 奉承话语的重复频率超过听者预期阈值时，会触发意图透明度反转，即从善意被重新解读为操控。
rule_en: When the repetition frequency of flattery exceeds the listener's expectation threshold, it triggers a reversal of perceived intent transparency, whereby goodwill is reinterpreted as manipulation.
text: When the repetition frequency of flattery exceeds the listener's expectation threshold, it triggers a reversal of perceived intent transparency, whereby goodwill is reinterpreted as manipulation.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 缺乏相关社会经验的个体容易将高语境下的策略性奉承误读为客观事实陈述。
rule_en: Individuals lacking relevant social experience tend to misinterpret strategic flattery in high-context settings as objective factual statements.
text: Individuals lacking relevant social experience tend to misinterpret strategic flattery in high-context settings as objective factual statements.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 第三方介入解释他人行为意图时，若未提供原始互动背景，会加剧接收者的认知偏差。
rule_en: Third-party interpretations of others' behavioral intentions lacking original interaction context exacerbate the receiver's cognitive bias.
text: Third-party interpretations of others' behavioral intentions lacking original interaction context exacerbate the receiver's cognitive bias.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 个体在评估他人奉承动机时，会无意识代入自身在类似情境下的利益诉求，导致投射性误判。
rule_en: When evaluating others' flattery motives, individuals unconsciously project their own situational self-interests, leading to projective misjudgment.
text: When evaluating others' flattery motives, individuals unconsciously project their own situational self-interests, leading to projective misjudgment.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 假装情境的边界模糊时，参与者对行为真实性的判断会向最近一次明确的现实锚点偏移。
rule_en: When the boundaries of a pretend context are blurred, participants' judgments of behavioral reality shift toward the most recent explicit reality anchor.
text: When the boundaries of a pretend context are blurred, participants' judgments of behavioral reality shift toward the most recent explicit reality anchor.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 奉承话语中夹杂的轻微否定或自我贬低，常被用作增强整体意图可信度的策略性缓冲。
rule_en: Mild negation or self-deprecation embedded within flattery often functions as a strategic buffer to enhance the credibility of the overall intent.
text: Mild negation or self-deprecation embedded within flattery often functions as a strategic buffer to enhance the credibility of the overall intent.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 认知图式固化的个体在面对超常规假装设定或非常规奉承模式时，倾向于强行套用旧有解释框架。
rule_en: Individuals with rigid cognitive schemas tend to force-fit unconventional pretense scenarios or atypical flattery patterns into preexisting explanatory frameworks.
text: Individuals with rigid cognitive schemas tend to force-fit unconventional pretense scenarios or atypical flattery patterns into preexisting explanatory frameworks.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 意图透明度的感知具有单向不对称性，发出者高估的透明度在接收者端往往被低估。
rule_en: The perception of intention transparency exhibits unidirectional asymmetry, wherein the transparency overestimated by the sender is typically underestimated by the receiver.
text: The perception of intention transparency exhibits unidirectional asymmetry, wherein the transparency overestimated by the sender is typically underestimated by the receiver.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 个体在缺乏直接证据的情况下，倾向于通过行为的一致性来反推隐藏意图的真实性或假装属性。
rule_en: In the absence of direct evidence, individuals tend to infer the authenticity or feigned nature of hidden intentions from behavioral consistency.
text: In the absence of direct evidence, individuals tend to infer the authenticity or feigned nature of hidden intentions from behavioral consistency.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 社会规范约束下的客套性赞美与策略性奉承在意图透明度上存在模糊地带，需依赖关系深度进行区分。
rule_en: Constrained by social norms, courtesy praise and strategic flattery exhibit ambiguity in intent transparency, requiring relational depth for differentiation.
text: Constrained by social norms, courtesy praise and strategic flattery exhibit ambiguity in intent transparency, requiring relational depth for differentiation.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 假装行为中的错误修正若由认知较弱方发起，常被强势方误判为规则创新而非认知纠正。
rule_en: Error corrections in pretend play initiated by the cognitively weaker party are often misconstrued by the dominant participant as rule innovation rather than cognitive correction.
text: Error corrections in pretend play initiated by the cognitively weaker party are often misconstrued by the dominant participant as rule innovation rather than cognitive correction.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 奉承话语的即时语境若与长期互动历史矛盾，接收者会优先采信历史累积的认知基线。
rule_en: When the immediate context of flattery contradicts long-term interaction history, recipients prioritize the historically accumulated cognitive baseline.
text: When the immediate context of flattery contradicts long-term interaction history, recipients prioritize the historically accumulated cognitive baseline.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 当个体试图隐藏真实意图时，语言复杂度与情感夸张度通常会呈正相关以转移认知注意力。
rule_en: When individuals attempt to conceal their true intentions, linguistic complexity and emotional exaggeration typically exhibit a positive correlation to divert cognitive attention.
text: When individuals attempt to conceal their true intentions, linguistic complexity and emotional exaggeration typically exhibit a positive correlation to divert cognitive attention.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 跨文化或跨语境交流中，假装规则的默认设定与奉承意图的解读基准存在系统性错位风险。
rule_en: In cross-cultural or cross-contextual communication, a systematic risk of misalignment exists between the default settings of pretense rules and the interpretive baselines for flattery intent.
text: In cross-cultural or cross-contextual communication, a systematic risk of misalignment exists between the default settings of pretense rules and the interpretive baselines for flattery intent.
title: Comprehensive

rule_zh: 当个体先验信念极强时，少量样本观察难以显著改变其原有判断。
rule_en: When an individual's prior beliefs are strongly held, limited sample observations are unlikely to significantly alter their initial judgments.
text: When an individual's prior beliefs are strongly held, limited sample observations are unlikely to significantly alter their initial judgments.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 样本容量越大且质量越高，其在最终推断中所占的权重应相应提升。
rule_en: The weight assigned to a sample in the final inference should increase correspondingly with its size and quality.
text: The weight assigned to a sample in the final inference should increase correspondingly with its size and quality.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 若观察样本明显存在选择偏差，推理时应降低该样本对先验信念的修正力度。
rule_en: If the observed sample exhibits significant selection bias, the degree to which it updates prior beliefs during inference should be reduced.
text: If the observed sample exhibits significant selection bias, the degree to which it updates prior beliefs during inference should be reduced.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 面对模糊或冲突的样本数据，个体倾向于更依赖原有的先验知识进行判断。
rule_en: When faced with ambiguous or conflicting sample data, individuals tend to rely more heavily on prior knowledge when making judgments.
text: When faced with ambiguous or conflicting sample data, individuals tend to rely more heavily on prior knowledge when making judgments.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 先验信息的不确定性越高，新观察到的样本对信念更新的影响力就越大。
rule_en: The higher the prior uncertainty, the greater the impact of newly observed samples on belief updating.
text: The higher the prior uncertainty, the greater the impact of newly observed samples on belief updating.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 连续多次观察到同类样本会加速信念向某一方向收敛，但收敛速度受先验锚定强度的制约。
rule_en: Repeated observations of homogeneous samples accelerate directional belief convergence, but the convergence rate is constrained by the strength of prior anchoring.
text: Repeated observations of homogeneous samples accelerate directional belief convergence, but the convergence rate is constrained by the strength of prior anchoring.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 当新样本与先验预期高度一致时，信念更新的幅度会相对保守，主要起强化作用而非方向逆转。
rule_en: When new samples strongly align with prior expectations, belief updating remains conservative in magnitude, primarily reinforcing rather than reversing the direction of belief.
text: When new samples strongly align with prior expectations, belief updating remains conservative in magnitude, primarily reinforcing rather than reversing the direction of belief.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 样本特征与总体关键属性的相关度越高，其作为更新证据的效力越强。
rule_en: The higher the correlation between sample characteristics and key population attributes, the greater their weight as updating evidence.
text: The higher the correlation between sample characteristics and key population attributes, the greater their weight as updating evidence.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 若个体意识到自身先验知识来源陈旧，面对新样本时会更主动地进行大幅度信念修正。
rule_en: If individuals recognize that their prior knowledge derives from outdated sources, they more proactively engage in substantial belief revision when encountering new samples.
text: If individuals recognize that their prior knowledge derives from outdated sources, they more proactively engage in substantial belief revision when encountering new samples.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 在缺乏明确总体基准的情况下，观察样本往往会被直接暂代为先验估计，用于后续推理。
rule_en: In the absence of an explicit population baseline, observed samples are often directly adopted as provisional prior estimates for subsequent inference.
text: In the absence of an explicit population baseline, observed samples are often directly adopted as provisional prior estimates for subsequent inference.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 多个独立来源的样本观察比单一来源的重复观察更能有效削弱有偏先验的影响。
rule_en: Sample observations from multiple independent sources more effectively attenuate the influence of a biased prior than repeated observations from a single source.
text: Sample observations from multiple independent sources more effectively attenuate the influence of a biased prior than repeated observations from a single source.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 先验估计若建立在长期稳定规律之上，其对短期异常样本的容忍度更高，不易发生过度修正。
rule_en: Prior estimates grounded in long-term stable patterns exhibit greater tolerance for short-term anomalous samples and are less prone to over-correction.
text: Prior estimates grounded in long-term stable patterns exhibit greater tolerance for short-term anomalous samples and are less prone to over-correction.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 观察者的注意力焦点会过滤部分样本信息，推理时需识别被忽略的样本以还原完整的更新过程。
rule_en: The observer's attentional focus filters partial sample information; inference requires identifying the omitted samples to reconstruct the complete update process.
text: The observer's attentional focus filters partial sample information; inference requires identifying the omitted samples to reconstruct the complete update process.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 若先验与样本在统计方向上完全背离，信念更新通常呈现阶梯式跳跃而非线性平滑过渡。
rule_en: When the prior and sample completely diverge in statistical direction, belief updating typically exhibits stepwise jumps rather than smooth linear transitions.
text: When the prior and sample completely diverge in statistical direction, belief updating typically exhibits stepwise jumps rather than smooth linear transitions.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 个体对样本可靠性的主观评估会动态调节先验与观察数据之间的权重分配比例。
rule_en: An individual's subjective assessment of sample reliability dynamically modulates the relative weighting between priors and observed data.
text: An individual's subjective assessment of sample reliability dynamically modulates the relative weighting between priors and observed data.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 在快速变化的环境中，近期的样本观察应被赋予比历史先验更高的决策权重。
rule_en: In rapidly changing environments, recent sample observations should be assigned greater decision weight than historical priors.
text: In rapidly changing environments, recent sample observations should be assigned greater decision weight than historical priors.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 先验信息若包含概率分布而非单一数值，信念更新应表现为整个分布形态的平移或展宽。
rule_en: When prior information comprises a probability distribution rather than a single value, belief updating should manifest as a shift or broadening of the entire distribution.
text: When prior information comprises a probability distribution rather than a single value, belief updating should manifest as a shift or broadening of the entire distribution.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 当样本观察受限于测量误差时，最终推断应保留向先验均值回归的倾向。
rule_en: When sample observations are subject to measurement error, the final inference should retain a tendency to regress toward the prior mean.
text: When sample observations are subject to measurement error, the final inference should retain a tendency to regress toward the prior mean.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 样本中出现的极端异常值在整合进信念时，需经过先验合理性的检验与过滤。
rule_en: Extreme sample outliers must undergo validation and filtering for prior plausibility before integration into beliefs.
text: Extreme sample outliers must undergo validation and filtering for prior plausibility before integration into beliefs.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 如果多个观察者的样本经验不同，整合其知识时应根据各自样本的代表性进行加权平均。
rule_en: If multiple observers possess differing sample experiences, their knowledge should be integrated via a weighted average proportional to the representativeness of their respective samples.
text: If multiple observers possess differing sample experiences, their knowledge should be integrated via a weighted average proportional to the representativeness of their respective samples.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 先验信念的置信区间宽度决定了新样本证据触发信念更新所需的最小阈值。
rule_en: The width of a prior belief's confidence interval determines the minimum threshold of new sample evidence required to trigger belief updating.
text: The width of a prior belief's confidence interval determines the minimum threshold of new sample evidence required to trigger belief updating.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 推理者若知晓先验信息来自权威但过时的来源，应赋予新样本更高的纠偏权重。
rule_en: If aware that prior information originates from an authoritative but outdated source, reasoners should assign higher debiasing weights to new samples.
text: If aware that prior information originates from an authoritative but outdated source, reasoners should assign higher debiasing weights to new samples.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 在样本信息不完整的情况下，先验框架能够填补观察空白，生成合理的整体推断。
rule_en: When sample information is incomplete, the prior framework fills observational gaps to generate plausible overall inferences.
text: When sample information is incomplete, the prior framework fills observational gaps to generate plausible overall inferences.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 若样本观察结果与领域内公认的常识性先验冲突，需提高对样本异常性或偏差性的怀疑。
rule_en: If sample observations contradict widely accepted commonsense priors in the domain, suspicion regarding sample anomaly or bias should be heightened.
text: If sample observations contradict widely accepted commonsense priors in the domain, suspicion regarding sample anomaly or bias should be heightened.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 信念更新并非一次性的点估计替换，而是基于先验与似然比进行渐进式概率调整的过程。
rule_en: Belief updating is not a one-time point-estimate replacement, but rather an incremental process of probabilistic adjustment based on priors and likelihood ratios.
text: Belief updating is not a one-time point-estimate replacement, but rather an incremental process of probabilistic adjustment based on priors and likelihood ratios.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 当不同维度或属性的样本信息交织时，各维度的先验权重需独立计算后再进行综合评估。
rule_en: When sample information across different dimensions or attributes is intertwined, the prior weights for each dimension must be computed independently prior to comprehensive evaluation.
text: When sample information across different dimensions or attributes is intertwined, the prior weights for each dimension must be computed independently prior to comprehensive evaluation.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 观察者若事先知道样本抽取机制是非随机的，必须在推断中引入相应的先验校准参数。
rule_en: If the observer knows in advance that the sampling mechanism is non-random, corresponding prior calibration parameters must be incorporated into the inference.
text: If the observer knows in advance that the sampling mechanism is non-random, corresponding prior calibration parameters must be incorporated into the inference.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 最终的知识表征应保持开放性，以允许未来新增样本对当前先验观察综合估计进行再修正。
rule_en: The final knowledge representation should remain open, allowing future additional samples to further revise the current comprehensive estimates derived from prior observations.
text: The final knowledge representation should remain open, allowing future additional samples to further revise the current comprehensive estimates derived from prior observations.
title: Knowledge

rule_zh: 使用“部分”通常语用暗示并非“全部”，在合作性语境中应默认排除极端全覆盖假设。
rule_en: The use of "some" typically pragmatically implies "not all"; in cooperative contexts, extreme full-coverage assumptions should be presumptively excluded.
text: The use of "some" typically pragmatically implies "not all"; in cooperative contexts, extreme full-coverage assumptions should be presumptively excluded.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 说话者选择弱化量词而非精确数值时，表明其传递的是相对分布图式而非绝对统计事实。
rule_en: When speakers choose vague quantifiers over precise numerical values, it indicates that they are conveying a relative distributional schema rather than absolute statistical facts.
text: When speakers choose vague quantifiers over precise numerical values, it indicates that they are conveying a relative distributional schema rather than absolute statistical facts.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 当说话者掌握完整信息却未使用“全部”，可推断其认知中存在已知的例外或不确定性边界。
rule_en: When a speaker possesses complete information yet omits "all", it implies cognitively acknowledged exceptions or boundaries of uncertainty.
text: When a speaker possesses complete information yet omits "all", it implies cognitively acknowledged exceptions or boundaries of uncertainty.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 听者应将量词强度排序转化为概率阶梯，推理时遵循强量词覆盖弱量词范围的层级约束。
rule_en: The listener should map the ordering of quantifier strength onto a probabilistic scale, adhering during reasoning to the hierarchical constraint that stronger quantifiers subsume the scope of weaker ones.
text: The listener should map the ordering of quantifier strength onto a probabilistic scale, adhering during reasoning to the hierarchical constraint that stronger quantifiers subsume the scope of weaker ones.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 若先验知识与量化陈述冲突，应以陈述作为信念更新的首要信号，而非机械维持原有分布预期。
rule_en: If prior knowledge conflicts with quantified statements, treat the statements as the primary signal for belief updating rather than mechanically maintaining original distributional expectations.
text: If prior knowledge conflicts with quantified statements, treat the statements as the primary signal for belief updating rather than mechanically maintaining original distributional expectations.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 并列量化陈述的各子集比例之和须在逻辑上受限于总体容量，避免推断出超量或空缺的矛盾组合。
rule_en: The sum of subset proportions in parallel quantified statements must be logically constrained by the total capacity, precluding contradictory inferences of excess or deficit.
text: The sum of subset proportions in parallel quantified statements must be logically constrained by the total capacity, precluding contradictory inferences of excess or deficit.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 否定性量化表达应转化为补集范围进行概率重估，通常指向少数或均分状态而非绝对真空。
rule_en: Negatively quantified expressions should be transformed into complementary ranges for probabilistic reassessment, typically indicating a minority or uniform distribution rather than absolute nullity.
text: Negatively quantified expressions should be transformed into complementary ranges for probabilistic reassessment, typically indicating a minority or uniform distribution rather than absolute nullity.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 说话者对特定对象使用弱化量词，往往反映该对象在其心理表征中处于非典型或次要地位。
rule_en: A speaker's use of attenuated quantifiers for a specific referent often reflects its atypical or secondary status in their mental representation.
text: A speaker's use of attenuated quantifiers for a specific referent often reflects its atypical or secondary status in their mental representation.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 观察样本显著偏离量化词预期时，应优先怀疑说话者存在信息滞后或认知偏差，而非立即推翻先验。
rule_en: When an observed sample significantly deviates from quantifier-derived expectations, priority should be given to suspecting the speaker's information lag or cognitive bias rather than immediately rejecting the prior.
text: When an observed sample significantly deviates from quantifier-derived expectations, priority should be given to suspecting the speaker's information lag or cognitive bias rather than immediately rejecting the prior.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: “某些”在分类语境中常暗示子集内部具有异质性，推理时应避免将其局部特征过度泛化至整体。
rule_en: In classification contexts, "certain" typically implies internal subset heterogeneity; reasoning should avoid overgeneralizing its localized features to the whole.
text: In classification contexts, "certain" typically implies internal subset heterogeneity; reasoning should avoid overgeneralizing its localized features to the whole.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 当说话者对模糊量词附加概率修饰时，听者的心理模型需同步引入相应的置信度衰减权重。
rule_en: When a speaker attaches a probabilistic modifier to a fuzzy quantifier, the listener's mental model must synchronously incorporate a corresponding confidence decay weight.
text: When a speaker attaches a probabilistic modifier to a fuzzy quantifier, the listener's mental model must synchronously incorporate a corresponding confidence decay weight.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 语用强化原则要求听者将未明确说明的强量词视为说话者有意隐瞒或不知，从而缩小合理推断区间。
rule_en: The principle of pragmatic strengthening requires the hearer to treat unexpressed strong quantifiers as deliberately concealed or unknown to the speaker, thereby narrowing the range of reasonable inferences.
text: The principle of pragmatic strengthening requires the hearer to treat unexpressed strong quantifiers as deliberately concealed or unknown to the speaker, thereby narrowing the range of reasonable inferences.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 在动态信息更新中，新证据若与量化断言不符，应调整量词的语义宽容度而非直接抛弃初始语境框架。
rule_en: In dynamic information updating, when new evidence conflicts with a quantified assertion, the semantic tolerance of the quantifier should be adjusted rather than directly abandoning the initial contextual framework.
text: In dynamic information updating, when new evidence conflicts with a quantified assertion, the semantic tolerance of the quantifier should be adjusted rather than directly abandoning the initial contextual framework.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 说话者使用量词描述他人状态时，该描述严格映射说话者自身的视角局限，不等同于客观真实分布。
rule_en: When a speaker uses quantifiers to describe others' states, the description strictly maps onto the speaker's epistemic constraints and is not equivalent to the objective distribution.
text: When a speaker uses quantifiers to describe others' states, the description strictly maps onto the speaker's epistemic constraints and is not equivalent to the objective distribution.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 面对矛盾的多源量化信息，应依据信息来源的知识完备性赋予权重，而非简单取平均值或多数决。
rule_en: When faced with conflicting multi-source quantitative information, weights should be assigned based on the knowledge completeness of the sources, rather than through simple averaging or majority rule.
text: When faced with conflicting multi-source quantitative information, weights should be assigned based on the knowledge completeness of the sources, rather than through simple averaging or majority rule.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 量词推理需区分字面逻辑下限与语用交际上限，常规交流中模糊下限常被强化为精确边界。
rule_en: Quantifier reasoning must distinguish between the literal logical lower bound and the pragmatic communicative upper bound; in routine communication, vague lower bounds are often strengthened into precise boundaries.
text: Quantifier reasoning must distinguish between the literal logical lower bound and the pragmatic communicative upper bound; in routine communication, vague lower bounds are often strengthened into precise boundaries.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 说话者避免绝对化量词往往意在保留修正余地或规避责任承诺，推断时应降低结论的断言力度。
rule_en: Speakers' avoidance of absolute quantifiers typically aims to preserve room for revision or evade commitment; therefore, the assertive force of conclusions should be moderated in inference.
text: Speakers' avoidance of absolute quantifiers typically aims to preserve room for revision or evade commitment; therefore, the assertive force of conclusions should be moderated in inference.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 极端主导与边缘补充量词并置时，推理应假设前者占据绝对优势，后者仅作为边界情形存在。
rule_en: When an extremely dominant quantifier is juxtaposed with a marginal supplementary quantifier, inference should assume the former holds absolute dominance, treating the latter solely as a boundary case.
text: When an extremely dominant quantifier is juxtaposed with a marginal supplementary quantifier, inference should assume the former holds absolute dominance, treating the latter solely as a boundary case.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 听者在归因信念时，若发现说话者系统性低估量词强度，可推断其存在风险规避或保守认知策略。
rule_en: During belief attribution, if listeners detect a speaker's systematic underestimation of quantifier strength, they may infer risk aversion or a conservative cognitive strategy.
text: During belief attribution, if listeners detect a speaker's systematic underestimation of quantifier strength, they may infer risk aversion or a conservative cognitive strategy.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 量化陈述的隐含排他性需结合领域常识校验，特定语境下弱量词可能严格保留逻辑包含关系。
rule_en: The implicit exclusivity of quantified statements requires validation against domain knowledge; in specific contexts, weak quantifiers may strictly preserve logical inclusion.
text: The implicit exclusivity of quantified statements requires validation against domain knowledge; in specific contexts, weak quantifiers may strictly preserve logical inclusion.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 当量化词用于假设性或反事实条件时，其推断功能转为构建心理模拟空间，而非反映现实比例。
rule_en: When quantifiers are used in hypothetical or counterfactual conditions, their inferential function shifts to constructing mental simulation spaces rather than reflecting actual proportions.
text: When quantifiers are used in hypothetical or counterfactual conditions, their inferential function shifts to constructing mental simulation spaces rather than reflecting actual proportions.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 听者整合量化信息时需保持单调性约束，强量词所断言的属性集合必须包含弱量词的对应集合。
rule_en: When integrating quantificational information, listeners must preserve monotonicity constraints: the set of properties asserted by a strong quantifier must contain the corresponding set of a weak quantifier.
text: When integrating quantificational information, listeners must preserve monotonicity constraints: the set of properties asserted by a strong quantifier must contain the corresponding set of a weak quantifier.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 说话者刻意交替使用相近强度的量词，通常暗示其在分类边界上存在认知模糊或决策犹豫。
rule_en: A speaker's deliberate alternation between quantifiers of comparable strength typically suggests cognitive ambiguity or decision hesitation regarding categorical boundaries.
text: A speaker's deliberate alternation between quantifiers of comparable strength typically suggests cognitive ambiguity or decision hesitation regarding categorical boundaries.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 推理过程应警惕将语用默认值误认为逻辑必然，需根据说话者合作程度动态调整隐含假设的严格性。
rule_en: Reasoning must guard against mistaking pragmatic defaults for logical necessity, dynamically adjusting the strictness of implicit assumptions according to the speaker's degree of cooperation.
text: Reasoning must guard against mistaking pragmatic defaults for logical necessity, dynamically adjusting the strictness of implicit assumptions according to the speaker's degree of cooperation.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 量化词的选择暴露了说话者的注意力分配，被赋予强量词的维度通常是其当前心理聚焦的核心。
rule_en: The choice of quantifiers reveals the speaker's attentional allocation, with dimensions marked by strong quantifiers typically representing the core of their current psychological focus.
text: The choice of quantifiers reveals the speaker's attentional allocation, with dimensions marked by strong quantifiers typically representing the core of their current psychological focus.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 在信念归因任务中，若量化陈述与直接观察相悖，应推断需修正的是先验参数而非否定观察事实。
rule_en: In belief attribution tasks, when quantitative statements conflict with direct observations, it should be inferred that prior parameters require revision rather than rejecting the observational facts.
text: In belief attribution tasks, when quantitative statements conflict with direct observations, it should be inferred that prior parameters require revision rather than rejecting the observational facts.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 非对称量词在基数较大时弹性极高，推理时应侧重其相对顺序与比较关系而非绝对数值。
rule_en: Asymmetric quantifiers exhibit high elasticity at large cardinalities; reasoning should prioritize their relative order and comparative relations over absolute values.
text: Asymmetric quantifiers exhibit high elasticity at large cardinalities; reasoning should prioritize their relative order and comparative relations over absolute values.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 说话者使用量词进行对比时，听者应推断出两者间存在显著的心理区隔或价值排序差异。
rule_en: When a speaker employs quantifiers comparatively, the hearer should infer a significant psychological distinction or divergence in value hierarchy between the two.
text: When a speaker employs quantifiers comparatively, the hearer should infer a significant psychological distinction or divergence in value hierarchy between the two.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 模糊量词的语用含义会随总体规模成比例缩放，推理时需将相对比例还原为情境适配的绝对阈值。
rule_en: The pragmatic meaning of fuzzy quantifiers scales proportionally with population size; inference requires converting relative proportions into context-specific absolute thresholds.
text: The pragmatic meaning of fuzzy quantifiers scales proportionally with population size; inference requires converting relative proportions into context-specific absolute thresholds.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 量化推理的终点是构建与说话者意图对齐的简化认知表征，而非追求数学分布的严格拟合。
rule_en: The endpoint of quantitative reasoning is to construct simplified cognitive representations aligned with the speaker's intent, rather than pursuing a strict fit to mathematical distributions.
text: The endpoint of quantitative reasoning is to construct simplified cognitive representations aligned with the speaker's intent, rather than pursuing a strict fit to mathematical distributions.
title: Scalar Implicature Test

rule_zh: 超出主体知识经验的行为细节不会在假装游戏中被复现
rule_en: Behavioral details beyond the subject's knowledge and experience are not reproduced in pretend play.
text: Behavioral details beyond the subject's knowledge and experience are not reproduced in pretend play.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 行为模仿出现偏差时，优先归因于主体对原型特征的认知不完整
rule_en: Deviations in behavioral imitation should be primarily attributed to the agent's incomplete cognition of prototypical features.
text: Deviations in behavioral imitation should be primarily attributed to the agent's incomplete cognition of prototypical features.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 模仿原型的提取概率与主体经验库中的熟悉度呈正相关
rule_en: The retrieval probability of an imitation prototype is positively correlated with its familiarity in the agent's experience repository.
text: The retrieval probability of an imitation prototype is positively correlated with its familiarity in the agent's experience repository.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 认知受限的模仿行为倾向于保留具象动作，而剥离抽象或隐蔽的属性
rule_en: Cognitively constrained imitation tends to preserve concrete actions while discarding abstract or latent attributes.
text: Cognitively constrained imitation tends to preserve concrete actions while discarding abstract or latent attributes.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 在多个可能原型中，优先选择主体接触频率最高或情感联结最强的对象
rule_en: Among multiple candidate prototypes, prioritize the object with the highest contact frequency or strongest emotional bond to the subject.
text: Among multiple candidate prototypes, prioritize the object with the highest contact frequency or strongest emotional bond to the subject.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 角色扮演的深度取决于主体对目标社会功能与互动规则的内化水平
rule_en: The depth of role-playing depends on the subject's level of internalization of the target social functions and interaction rules.
text: The depth of role-playing depends on the subject's level of internalization of the target social functions and interaction rules.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 复杂假装行为需按认知模块拆解，逐一验证每个片段的知识来源
rule_en: Complex pretense behavior must be decomposed into cognitive modules, with each segment's knowledge source verified individually.
text: Complex pretense behavior must be decomposed into cognitive modules, with each segment's knowledge source verified individually.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 陌生情境下的假装行为本质是已知经验的跨域映射，其核心锚点必存在于原有认知中
rule_en: Pretend behavior in unfamiliar contexts is fundamentally a cross-domain mapping of prior experience, with its core anchor necessarily rooted in pre-existing cognition.
text: Pretend behavior in unfamiliar contexts is fundamentally a cross-domain mapping of prior experience, with its core anchor necessarily rooted in pre-existing cognition.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 对假装对象的命名错误或自创词汇，揭示了主体概念分类的认知边界
rule_en: Naming errors or self-coined terms for pretend objects reveal the cognitive boundaries of the subject's conceptual categorization.
text: Naming errors or self-coined terms for pretend objects reveal the cognitive boundaries of the subject's conceptual categorization.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 外部刺激仅在与主体经验库匹配时才能激活对应的模仿序列
rule_en: External stimuli activate the corresponding imitation sequence only when matching the subject's experience repository.
text: External stimuli activate the corresponding imitation sequence only when matching the subject's experience repository.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 行为特征的简化或夸张是主体记忆提取优先级的体现，而非原型客观面貌
rule_en: The simplification or exaggeration of behavioral features reflects the subject's memory retrieval priority rather than the objective reality of the prototype.
text: The simplification or exaggeration of behavioral features reflects the subject's memory retrieval priority rather than the objective reality of the prototype.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 确认为假装模仿需验证行为序列与主体内在脚本的结构匹配度，排除随机巧合
rule_en: Confirming pretend imitation requires verifying the structural alignment between the behavioral sequence and the subject's internal script to rule out random coincidence.
text: Confirming pretend imitation requires verifying the structural alignment between the behavioral sequence and the subject's internal script to rule out random coincidence.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 文化或环境背景缺失的特定仪式与工具动作，无法进入主体的模仿备选集
rule_en: Specific ritual and tool-use actions lacking cultural or environmental context cannot enter the subject's imitation candidate set.
text: Specific ritual and tool-use actions lacking cultural or environmental context cannot enter the subject's imitation candidate set.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 假装行为的复杂度随主体新知识摄入与认知网络扩展而呈现阶梯式演进
rule_en: The complexity of pretend behavior evolves stepwise with the subject's acquisition of new knowledge and cognitive network expansion.
text: The complexity of pretend behavior evolves stepwise with the subject's acquisition of new knowledge and cognitive network expansion.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 对抽象或虚构原型的模仿，其合法性完全建立在符号表征或媒介暴露史之上
rule_en: The legitimacy of imitating abstract or fictional archetypes rests entirely upon symbolic representation or a history of media exposure.
text: The legitimacy of imitating abstract or fictional archetypes rests entirely upon symbolic representation or a history of media exposure.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 主体会基于自身逻辑框架自动补全知识缺口，补全内容反映主观建构而非客观事实
rule_en: Subjects automatically fill knowledge gaps based on their inherent logical frameworks, with the resulting content reflecting subjective construction rather than objective facts.
text: Subjects automatically fill knowledge gaps based on their inherent logical frameworks, with the resulting content reflecting subjective construction rather than objective facts.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 真实与假装互动的分野在于行为是否受限于主体对交互规则的简化理解
rule_en: The distinction between genuine and pretense interactions lies in whether behavior is constrained by the agent's simplified understanding of interaction rules.
text: The distinction between genuine and pretense interactions lies in whether behavior is constrained by the agent's simplified understanding of interaction rules.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 协作型假装游戏的可持续性取决于参与者认知范围的重叠程度与共识建立
rule_en: The sustainability of collaborative pretend play depends on the extent of overlap in participants' cognitive scopes and consensus formation.
text: The sustainability of collaborative pretend play depends on the extent of overlap in participants' cognitive scopes and consensus formation.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 行为序列中的迟疑或替代动作通常标记认知检索边界，提示原型匹配的不确定性
rule_en: Hesitations or alternative actions in behavioral sequences typically mark cognitive retrieval boundaries, indicating uncertainty in prototype matching.
text: Hesitations or alternative actions in behavioral sequences typically mark cognitive retrieval boundaries, indicating uncertainty in prototype matching.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 异常假装行为往往是既有知识节点的非典型组合，而非完全脱离认知范围的凭空创造
rule_en: Atypical pretend behavior often represents an unconventional combination of existing knowledge nodes, rather than a creation entirely detached from cognitive boundaries.
text: Atypical pretend behavior often represents an unconventional combination of existing knowledge nodes, rather than a creation entirely detached from cognitive boundaries.
title: Knowledge-Pretend Play Links

rule_zh: 视线方向不等同于实际注意力焦点，缺乏伴随的感知行为时不能断定注意已分配
rule_en: Gaze direction does not equate to actual attentional focus; in the absence of accompanying perceptual behaviors, attention allocation cannot be inferred.
text: Gaze direction does not equate to actual attentional focus; in the absence of accompanying perceptual behaviors, attention allocation cannot be inferred.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 当认知负荷较高或存在强干扰源时注意力易被分散，不能默认个体注意到所有显著刺激
rule_en: Under high cognitive load or in the presence of strong distractors, attention is easily diverted; thus, it cannot be assumed that individuals attend to all salient stimuli.
text: Under high cognitive load or in the presence of strong distractors, attention is easily diverted; thus, it cannot be assumed that individuals attend to all salient stimuli.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 在多个目标竞争注意力的情境下无法确立个体对单一对象的稳定注意，偏好推断需保持悬置
rule_en: In contexts of attentional competition among multiple targets, stable attention to a single object cannot be established, necessitating the suspension of preference inferences.
text: In contexts of attentional competition among multiple targets, stable attention to a single object cannot be established, necessitating the suspension of preference inferences.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 偏好形成依赖充分的注意力投入与信息整合，注意力状态模糊时不得推断确定性偏好
rule_en: Preference formation requires sufficient attentional investment and information integration; definite preferences must not be inferred when attentional states are ambiguous.
text: Preference formation requires sufficient attentional investment and information integration; definite preferences must not be inferred when attentional states are ambiguous.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 仅凭空间共现或物理临近性不足以证明注意力分配，必须存在明确的定向或交互线索
rule_en: Spatial co-occurrence or physical proximity alone is insufficient to demonstrate attention allocation; explicit directional or interactive cues must be present.
text: Spatial co-occurrence or physical proximity alone is insufficient to demonstrate attention allocation; explicit directional or interactive cues must be present.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 短暂视线偏离未伴随明确中断信号时应假设注意力仍维持原有状态，不宜轻易否定其信息获取
rule_en: In the absence of explicit disengagement cues, brief gaze deviation should be presumed to reflect sustained attention, and information acquisition should not be readily discounted.
text: In the absence of explicit disengagement cues, brief gaze deviation should be presumed to reflect sustained attention, and information acquisition should not be readily discounted.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 注意力不确定性会阻断从感知到知识表征的转化，进而使后续偏好推断失去有效前提
rule_en: Attentional uncertainty disrupts the transformation from perception to knowledge representation, thereby depriving subsequent preference inference of a valid premise.
text: Attentional uncertainty disrupts the transformation from perception to knowledge representation, thereby depriving subsequent preference inference of a valid premise.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 对某对象缺乏选择性行为反应时个体可能处于弥散注意状态，无法据此推导特定偏好
rule_en: The absence of selective behavioral responses to a given object may indicate a diffuse attentional state, precluding inference of specific preferences.
text: The absence of selective behavioral responses to a given object may indicate a diffuse attentional state, precluding inference of specific preferences.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 信息被部分遮挡或呈现不完整时注意力验证受阻，此时推断个体偏好属于过度外推
rule_en: When information is partially obscured or incompletely presented, hindering attentional verification, inferring individual preferences constitutes overextrapolation.
text: When information is partially obscured or incompletely presented, hindering attentional verification, inferring individual preferences constitutes overextrapolation.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 即使目标物理显著性高在未观察到注意捕获行为前仍应视其处于潜在注意盲区
rule_en: Despite high physical salience, a target should still be considered to reside in a potential attentional blind spot prior to observed attentional capture.
text: Despite high physical salience, a target should still be considered to reside in a potential attentional blind spot prior to observed attentional capture.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 注意力在多事件间快速切换会降低加工深度，无法支撑对任一事件相关偏好的确定性结论
rule_en: Rapid attentional switching across multiple events reduces processing depth, failing to support definitive conclusions regarding preferences for any specific event.
text: Rapid attentional switching across multiple events reduces processing depth, failing to support definitive conclusions regarding preferences for any specific event.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 缺乏明确注意锚定信号意味着目标可能仅处于背景加工层级，不足以支撑稳定偏好的生成
rule_en: The absence of explicit attentional anchoring signals implies that the target may only undergo background-level processing, insufficient to support the formation of stable preferences.
text: The absence of explicit attentional anchoring signals implies that the target may only undergo background-level processing, insufficient to support the formation of stable preferences.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 偏好具有情境依赖性，当当前注意力状态存疑时不能将历史偏好直接迁移至新对象
rule_en: Preferences are context-dependent; historical preferences should not be directly transferred to new objects when the current attentional state is uncertain.
text: Preferences are context-dependent; historical preferences should not be directly transferred to new objects when the current attentional state is uncertain.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 注意力资源存在容量上限，并行处理多任务会稀释对特定对象的注意强度，偏好指向随之模糊
rule_en: Attentional resources are capacity-limited; parallel multitasking dilutes attentional intensity toward specific targets, thereby blurring preference direction.
text: Attentional resources are capacity-limited; parallel multitasking dilutes attentional intensity toward specific targets, thereby blurring preference direction.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 无法确认个体是否注意到关键属性变更时任何基于该属性变化的偏好推断均应视为无效
rule_en: When it cannot be confirmed whether an individual has noticed a change in key attributes, any preference inference based on such change shall be deemed invalid.
text: When it cannot be confirmed whether an individual has noticed a change in key attributes, any preference inference based on such change shall be deemed invalid.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 中性或模糊的行为反馈通常暗示注意力未有效聚焦，此时不宜得出强偏好倾向的判断
rule_en: Neutral or ambiguous behavioral feedback typically indicates insufficient attentional focus, rendering strong preference judgments unwarranted.
text: Neutral or ambiguous behavioral feedback typically indicates insufficient attentional focus, rendering strong preference judgments unwarranted.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 只有当注意力被明确引导并维持在某目标上足够时长方可建立该目标与个体偏好的可靠关联
rule_en: Only when attention is explicitly directed to and sustained on a target for a sufficient duration can a reliable association between that target and individual preference be established.
text: Only when attention is explicitly directed to and sustained on a target for a sufficient duration can a reliable association between that target and individual preference be established.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 处于注意盲区的事件无法进入工作记忆加工，基于此类事件的偏好推断必然缺乏认知支撑
rule_en: Events in the attentional blind spot cannot enter working memory processing; preference inferences based on them necessarily lack cognitive support.
text: Events in the attentional blind spot cannot enter working memory processing; preference inferences based on them necessarily lack cognitive support.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 在无法区分物理可见与心理注意的情境下推理应保守评估知识状态并暂缓偏好结论
rule_en: In contexts where physical visibility and psychological attention are indistinguishable, reasoning should conservatively assess knowledge states and suspend preferred conclusions.
text: In contexts where physical visibility and psychological attention are indistinguishable, reasoning should conservatively assess knowledge states and suspend preferred conclusions.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 注意力不确定性的存在要求模型采用保守推断原则，将偏好视为概率分布而非确定状态
rule_en: The presence of attention uncertainty requires the model to adopt a conservative inference principle, treating preferences as probability distributions rather than deterministic states.
text: The presence of attention uncertainty requires the model to adopt a conservative inference principle, treating preferences as probability distributions rather than deterministic states.
title: Knowledge-Attention Links

rule_zh: 当对方因信息不足而产生犹豫时，填补关键认知缺口比泛泛强调目标价值更具说服力。
rule_en: When hesitation stems from informational deficits, bridging critical cognitive gaps proves more persuasive than broadly emphasizing goal value.
text: When hesitation stems from informational deficits, bridging critical cognitive gaps proves more persuasive than broadly emphasizing goal value.
